Thanks Olga — reviewed the map_v3 draft. Quick notes inline:

- Scope option A (phased pilot): accepts truncated dataset and runs inference for clinical review. Can start within 1 week after we spin up environment. (Owner: Redwood delivery)
- Scope B (full pilot): requires full data and privacy review — timeline +3 weeks. (Owner: Nimbus IT / procurement)
- Proposed mitigations: provide 20% onboarding credit if they pick full pilot and need procurement flexibility; offer 2 dedicated onboarding days from delivery engineering to compress runbook setup.

Risk register additions:
1) Data availability slip (likelihood: medium, impact: high) — mitigation: phased pilot or synthetic data staging.
2) SOC/Privacy review delay — mitigation: offer expedited security evidence pack and 2-hour review call with security SME.

If procurement is pushing hard, we should prepare an exec summary and a one-paragraph ask for Rishi to take to Sales Ops / CRO: (a) approve a one-time onboarding credit, (b) confirm availability of two delivery days, (c) sign an updated MAP with new close date.
